n_9aa4cad36055daff.name: Read the TRON address
n_9aa4cad36055daff.source: export default function input({body}){const m=body?.message,id=m?.chat?.id,reply=m?.message_id;if(!Number.isSafeInteger(id)||id===0||!Number.isSafeInteger(reply)||reply<=0)throw Error('Invalid Telegram message');const address=typeof m.text==='string'?m.text:'';return{chatId:String(id),replyToMessageId:reply,address,looksValid:/^T[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{33}$/.test(address),request:{address,visible:true},text:'Please enter a complete valid TRON address.'}}

n_8b65f9512eccdb46.name: Prepare the USDT contract query
n_8b65f9512eccdb46.source: export default function validate({body,address}){if(!body||typeof body!=='object'||typeof body.result!=='boolean')throw Error('TRON address validation unavailable');if(!body.result)return{valid:false,request:{},text:'Please enter a complete valid TRON address.'};const alphabet='123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz';let n=0n;for(const c of address){const v=alphabet.indexOf(c);if(v<0)throw Error('Invalid address');n=n*58n+BigInt(v)}const hex=n.toString(16).padStart(50,'0');if(hex.length!==50||!hex.startsWith('41'))throw Error('Invalid TRON address bytes');const parameter=hex.slice(2,42).padStart(64,'0'),contract='TR7NHqjeKQxGTCi8q8ZY4pL8otSzgjLj6t';return{valid:true,request:{owner_address:contract,contract_address:contract,function_selector:'getBlackListStatus(address)',parameter,visible:true},text:'Please enter a complete valid TRON address.'}}

n_f9577eea6cfe9659.name: Interpret the contract result
n_f9577eea6cfe9659.source: export default function result({body,address}){if(!body||body.result?.result!==true||!Array.isArray(body.constant_result)||body.constant_result.length!==1||typeof body.constant_result[0]!=='string'||!/^0{63}[01]$/.test(body.constant_result[0]))throw Error('USDT contract result unavailable');const blacklisted=body.constant_result[0].endsWith('1');return{text:blacklisted?`TRON USDT contract reports ${address} is blacklisted.`:`TRON USDT contract reports ${address} is not blacklisted.`}}
